comment_usage: Use this scaffold when prompting an AI assistant to convert bilingual (English/Arabic) HTML questions into the JSON structure expected by the Auto Body Technician study app.

questions.comment: Replace each placeholder with real content parsed from the HTML source.
questions.comment_uid: Follow the naming convention: 'B' + Book Number + MWA Letter + Task Code + 'q' + Question Number.

question.en: Main English stem extracted from the HTML goes here.
question.ar: نص السؤال باللغة العربية كما هو في المصدر.

explanation.comment_explanation: Include both a quick summary in 'plain' and a structured 'richText' array. Supported block types: paragraph, heading, list (style = 'ordered' or 'unordered'), note (variant = info|success|warning|danger), quote, divider, and inline HTML spans for colour.

en.plain: Summarise the English rationale in one or two sentences.

richText.content: State the core reason the answer is correct and reference the relevant specification.

items: Step-by-step reasoning or diagnostic cues derived from the HTML explanation.

items.content: Highlight numeric values with colour when emphasised in the source, e.g. Torque to 45 Nm.

richText.title: Technician Tip
richText.content: Keep the panel temperature within the OEM range to prevent paint failure.
اشرح السبب الرئيسي للإجابة الصحيحة، ويمكن استخدام التنسيق أو التسطير بحسب الحاجة.

items: إعادة صياغة التفسير في نقاط موجزة.

items.content: تمييز القيم المهمة بلون مناسب مثل 45 نيوتن متر.
